**History of Life and Death.** **227**

<margin>04</margin> let us inquire; for the proper
work of cold is *Condensation*; and
it is performed without any
malignity or hostile quality:
and therefore the operation is safer
than by *Opiates*; though a little
less powerful if it were used
only by turns, just as *Opiates*
are used: But again, because it
can be applied familiarly and in
daily diet in a moderate way, it is
also far more powerful for the prolonga-
tion of life than through *Opiates*.

<margin>39</margin> *Refrigeration of the Spirits* is performed in three
ways; Either by *Respiration*;
Or by *Vapors*; Or by *Food*:
The first is the best, but almost
beyond our power; The second is
also powerful, and yet it is at hand;
The third is weak and works through
circuits.

*Air*

<summary>Bacon argues that because cold condenses the spirits without harm, it serves as a safer and more effective tool for longevity than opiates, provided it is applied through daily diet and lifestyle. He classifies the methods of cooling the spirits into respiration, vapors, and food.</summary>
<keywords>condensation, spirits, cold, refrigeration, respiration, vapors, food, longevity, Bacon</keywords>
